title: Design System: AWS MLOps Reference Platform

title.purpose: Names evidence panels and system stories.

data.purpose: Carries tables, results, and form values.

shadows.name: crt-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates the curved shell from the page field.

shadows.name: crt-inset
shadows.purpose: Adds restrained phosphor bloom inside the shell.

shadows.name: active-control
shadows.purpose: Marks a hovered or selected interactive frame.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Changes terminal keys, fields, and command buttons.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Changes architecture nodes and evidence tabs.

motion.name: cursor-route
motion.purpose: Moves the evidence cursor between proof categories.

motion.name: trace-pulse
motion.purpose: Runs one slow pulse through the lifecycle route.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Resolves animation and transitions to a static state.

components.name: Terminal Key
components.description: Moves visitors between architecture, source, and prediction evidence.
components.html: TRACE THE PLATFORM
components.css: .ds-terminal-key { display: inline-flex; gap: .9rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.4rem; padding: .75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--phosphor-faint, #264a20); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--panel, #061007); color: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); font: 400 1.2rem/1 VT323, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-terminal-key svg { width: 1.45rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.3; } .ds-terminal-key:hover { border-color: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); background: var(--action-active, #0a1c0c); color: var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.38); } .ds-terminal-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Command Button
components.description: Submits a schema-driven prediction or subscription request.
components.css: .ds-command-button { min-height: 3rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); border-radius: 1px; background: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); color: var(--ink, #020603); font: 700 1.2rem/1 VT323, monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-command-button:hover { background: var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.36); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-command-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-command-button:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-command-button:disabled { cursor: progress; opacity: .55; transform: none; }

components.name: Terminal Field
components.description: Collects readable schema and subscription values inside dense panels.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .55rem; color: #79af67; font: 400 .68rem/1.55 SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Code', 'Liberation Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-terminal-field { min-height: 2.65rem; padding: .55rem .65rem; border: 1px solid var(--phosphor-faint, #264a20); border-radius: 1px; outline: none; background: var(--field-background, #030904); color: var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); caret-color: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); font: 400 .82rem/1.55 SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Code', 'Liberation Mono', monospace; } .ds-terminal-field::placeholder { color: #6d9f5c; } .ds-terminal-field:hover, .ds-terminal-field:focus { border-color: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(141,255,77,.2); } .ds-terminal-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Architecture Stage
components.description: Selects one lifecycle stage without breaking the connected route.
components.css: .ds-stage-node { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 8.5rem; padding: 1rem .4rem .65rem; border: 1px solid var(--phosphor-faint, #264a20); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--panel, #061007); color: var(--body-copy, #bafc8c); cursor: pointer; } .ds-stage-node svg { width: 3rem; height: 3rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.25; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; } .ds-stage-node span { margin-top: .7rem; font: 400 1.35rem/1 VT323, monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-stage-node:hover, .ds-stage-node[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); background: var(--panel-strong, #09180b); color: var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.36), inset 0 0 1.2rem rgba(77,176,54,.12); } .ds-stage-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence Tab
components.description: Selects implemented, deployed, or observed proof without implying completion.
components.css: .ds-evidence-tab { display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; width: 14rem; min-height: 10rem; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--phosphor-faint, #264a20); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--phosphor-dim, #5ca83c); cursor: pointer; text-align: center; } .ds-evidence-tab svg { width: 3rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.2; } .ds-evidence-tab span { margin-top: .65rem; font: 400 1.45rem/1 VT323, monospace; letter-spacing: .11em; } .ds-evidence-tab small { max-width: 24ch; margin-top: .5rem; color: #79af67; font: 400 .64rem/1.45 SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Code', 'Liberation Mono', monospace; } .ds-evidence-tab:hover, .ds-evidence-tab[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); background: rgba(71,155,50,.08); } .ds-evidence-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Trace Ledger Row
components.description: Selects one architecture route and exposes its exact AWS component chain.
components.css: .ds-trace-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7rem 1fr; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-width: 28rem; min-height: 2.6rem; padding: 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--phosphor-dim, #5ca83c); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--phosphor-dim, #5ca83c); background: transparent; color: var(--phosphor-dim, #5ca83c); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-trace-row span { font: 400 1.15rem/1 VT323, monospace; letter-spacing: .11em; } .ds-trace-row i { position: relative; display: block; border-top: 1px dashed currentColor; } .ds-trace-row i::before, .ds-trace-row i::after { position: absolute; top: -.25rem; width: .45rem; height: .45rem; border: 1px solid var(--phosphor-dim, #5ca83c); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--panel, #061007); content: ''; } .ds-trace-row i::before { left: 22%; } .ds-trace-row i::after { right: 12%; } .ds-trace-row:hover, .ds-trace-row[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); background: rgba(71,155,50,.06); } .ds-trace-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Prediction Console
components.description: Frames the secondary schema-driven demo as a terminal process.
components.html: POST /API/PREDICTSCHEMA-DRIVEN REQUEST
components.css: .ds-console { width: min(38rem, 100%); border: 1px solid var(--phosphor-dim, #5ca83c); background: rgba(5,15,6,.78); box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.4); color: var(--body-copy, #bafc8c); font-family: SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Code', 'Liberation Mono', monospace; } .ds-console header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: .85rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--phosphor-faint, #264a20); color: var(--phosphor-dim, #5ca83c); font-size: .68rem; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-console-body { display: grid; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-console label { display: grid; gap: .55rem; color: #79af67; font-size: .68rem; } .ds-console input { min-height: 2.65rem; padding: .55rem .65rem; border: 1px solid var(--phosphor-faint, #264a20); border-radius: 1px; background: var(--field-background, #030904); color: var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); } .ds-console input:focus { border-color: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); outline: 2px solid var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-console button { justify-self: end; min-height: 3rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); border-radius: 1px; background: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); color: var(--ink, #020603); font: 700 1.2rem/1 VT323, monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-console button:hover { background: var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); } .ds-console button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phosphor-bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The system presents architecture as a near-black phosphor dossier. A curved CRT shell contains exact routes, authored line icons, and evidence boundaries.

The visual voice stays technical, calm, and dense. Bright signals mark active relationships. Dim rules preserve the structure without competing with content.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black CRT glass with restrained scanlines and perimeter bloom.
Phosphor linework that links architecture stages with evidence categories.
Bitmap display type paired with readable system monospace text.
Flat evidence frames with precise borders and controlled state depth.
One routed trace pulse, with a static reduced-motion state.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Bright phosphor MUST identify a current action, selection, focus target, or primary readout.

rules.name: The Fault Isolation Rule
rules.body: Warm fault colors MUST appear only in error states.

rules.name: The Two Voice Rule
rules.body: Display text and controls MUST use VT323. Body text and data MUST use the system monospace stack.

rules.name: The Shell Depth Rule
rules.body: The CRT shell MUST own the strongest ambient shadow. Internal frames MUST use borders at rest.

dos: Do: New screens MUST preserve the two-voice type system.
Do: Evidence relationships MUST use semantic HTML or authored SVG.
Do: Responsive layouts MUST keep the content order readable without the desktop route overlay.
Do: Motion MUST resolve to a static path when the visitor requests reduced motion.
donts: Don't: New screens MUST NOT place semantic evidence inside a raster image.
Don't: Active states MUST NOT use glow without a border, route, or label.
Don't: Sequential architecture MUST NOT become isolated tiles when the route relationship carries meaning.
Don't: Error colors MUST NOT decorate neutral or successful states.
